author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Gmail now offers the option to change your email address. It’s fast and it’s easy. But should you do it? In this video, you'll learn how to change your Gmail address and learn what happens to your original address.

What you’ll learn:
• Identify common concerns related to changing your email address
• What happens to your original email address when you change your address
• Working with “Alternate Emails” in Gmail

Host: Nick Brazzi 
#gmail #google #googlemail
